display_long_description:
**🏑Become a pro goalkeeper using the best VR Mixed Reality Hockey game on Meta Quest!🏑** Improve your fitness, reaction time and health as you climb up the ranks and become a Hockey Goalie Pro!


**👑 Rise through the Ranks**

Watch as your space is transformed into various Hockey Stadiums with Mixed Reality environments. Complete Challenges as you guard the goal and improve your rank!

[media]

**🥊 Fitness**

Improve your reaction time and your health as a Hockey Goalie in VR with Hand tracking or controller support and predictive reaction technology for close-to-real life experience!

[media]

**🏒 Upgrade your Gear**

Spend some time browsing the shop to customise and upgrade your gear and access new areas.
